name: Causally identifiable stream
known_effect: one-factor randomized weekly offer; other keys at the customer optimum; purchase intensity rises only when the drawn offer is the customer's optimum, scaled by latent price sensitivity.
why: rabbit_hole declares the weekly randomized offer arm, its action keys and the per-customer known optimum; the stream carries the randomized levels. This is the stream the B4.2 OPE and the judge RL/simulator legs consume.
